name: Hablaki
summary: Voice dictation for Mac and Windows that runs on your own computer: press a key, speak, and the text is pasted where your cursor is in any app. Spanish, English, French, Portuguese, German and Italian.
best_for: people who write a lot on a Mac or Windows PC in one of its six listed languages and want dictation or file transcription in any app, processed on their own computer, without a subscription
skip_if: you need dictation on your phone, proven accuracy in a language beyond the six it lists, or transcription that never touches the internet at all
honest_knock: Spanish is the default language and the site lists six languages (Spanish, English, French, Portuguese, German and Italian); Hablaki says the underlying model supports more than 99, but without a promise of equal accuracy outside those six. It is not fully offline: the first model download, licence activation and periodic licence checks need an internet connection. On Intel Macs and Windows it transcribes more slowly, with a lighter voice component. There is no mobile app yet; Android is on the roadmap. Refunds are standard only within 14 days of purchase.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Hablaki licence · one-time lifetime licence for up to 2 computers, Mac or Windows, updates included, no subscription
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-02 on hablaki.com/en, its FAQ and the refund policy at hablaki.com/en/refunds; the Spanish homepage, read 2026-10-21, gives the same 9,99 USD) Hablaki sells one thing: a lifetime licence for $9.99, paid once, with no subscription and no account. One licence covers up to 2 of your computers, and the same licence works on Mac and on Windows. Updates are included for life, the homepage says. You can try it for 14 days first without a card, and if it does not work for you there is a refund within 14 days of purchase, handled by Lemon Squeezy as merchant of record; after a refund the licence is deactivated. Separately, Hablaki runs a free web transcriber in beta for audio files, limited to 5 transcriptions a day of up to 1 hour each. Re-read on 14 November 2026 with a plain fetch of hablaki.com/en/pricing, the terms and the refund policy: $9.99 once for a lifetime licence on up to 2 computers, unchanged. The refund policy (updated 15 October 2026) now names facturacion@hablaki.com as the address for refund requests.
